changes: Clip Ambient no longer participates in VK flex layout; settings button is fixed overlay and does not shift carousel.
Clip Ambient geometry is derived from actual video edges, never the 800px clip card.
Clip Ambient panel hides incompatible letterbox-fill setting and bar controls.
VK transcript search now prioritizes the main video, retries longer, activates disabled tracks temporarily, and also fetches direct <track src> resources.
Removed the duplicate transcript_search runtime from the manifest to avoid competing active-video state.
